info.description: Where something is, as a picture or as an embedded map.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Label
edit.description: The words on the button that opens the map. Left empty, it reads "View on Maps".

edit.label: Address
edit.description: The address as it should be read. Line breaks are kept.

edit.label: Map URL
edit.description: Where the map opens when the picture is clicked.

edit.label: Image
edit.description: A drawn or photographed map. Fill this in and the page makes no request to Google at all; leave it empty and a Google Map is embedded, which loads their scripts and sets their cookies before the visitor has done anything.
